newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA INTERBANK DEPO RATES FLAT IN LIGHT VOLUME.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA INTERBANK DEPO RATES FLAT IN LIGHT VOLUME.

text.p: Activity was light on Bulgaria's interbank deposit market due to low demand for lev funds and interest rates were unchanged from Monday, dealers said.
"Trade is very thin. Demand is low because banks either have high free (lev) liquidity or sell foreign currency for levs to meet current payments," a trader said.

Interbank depo rates stood at 1.00-1.50 percent annually for periods between one day and one week, unchanged from Monday. Rates for periods between two and four weeks were 2.5-2.7 percent annually, dealers said.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 1.42 percent on Monday, lower than 1.03 percent on Friday, a central bank official said.
A new central bank main lev interest rate of 5.59 percent annually took effect on Monday, up from 5.50 percent last week. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
